operating_notes.text: The Endowment Tribunal, Telangana has directed GOCL not to alienate its leased land at Kukatpally, Hyderabad, or alternatively to provide adequate security; the company is reviewing the order.
Total of 157.21 acres of Kukatpally land sold as of 31 March 2026 out of 264.50 acres under the MoU with Squarespace Builders.
Entered into an Agreement to Sell on 27 March 2026 with SPVs of Tata Realty for the Ecopolis Yelahanka property for approximately ₹81,500 lakh; received ₹100 lakh advance.
NCLT directed convening of meetings of Equity Shareholders and Unsecured Creditors for HNPCL merger on November 24, 2026.
During Q2FY27, received an advance of ₹111.68 Cr (net) from Squarespace Builders under the Kukatpally land sale MoU; total 157.21 acres sold till 30 Sep 2026.
NCLT Amaravati Bench ordered the meeting via order dated October 08, 2026.

timeline.summary: On 20 April 2026, GOCL disclosed that the Endowment Tribunal, Telangana had directed it not to alienate its leased land at Kukatpally, Hyderabad, or alternatively to provide adequate security; the company said it was reviewing the order and expected no material adverse impact.
On 20 May 2026, GOCL announced the receipt of a no-adverse-observation letter from BSE Limited for its proposed merger by absorption of Hinduja National Power Corporation Limited.
GOCL noted the NCLT order directing meetings of shareholders and unsecured creditors for the HNPCL merger on November 24, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4.11 Cr (+85.1% YoY), net profit ₹40.5 Cr (+188.7% YoY).
GOCL Corporation announced an NCLT-convened meeting of equity shareholders for November 24, 2026, to consider the merger of Hinduja National Power Corporation.
